summary: Data retention exception and targeted log scrub for AtlasHealth after DSAR escalation
description:
Issue summary: AtlasHealth (enterprise customer) submitted a DSAR escalation requesting removal of specific user PII from production logs between 2026-02-25 and 2026-03-02. Impact: Potential compliance breach if logs containing PII are not removed; customer is pausing ingestion of new data until confirmation is provided. Request: Evaluate feasibility of targeted log redact/scrub for the date range and provide legal-signed approval for the operation.

Background: Support previously handled a standard DSAR (SUP-4821) but customer escalated citing HIPAA scope. Logs are stored in centralized Loki cluster with S3 cold backup. Some telemetry and request metadata contain user identifiers. Need a cross-team plan involving SRE, Security/Privacy, and Legal.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) N/A - customer-provided request for retroactive deletion of log rows.
2) Context: query used to identify affected log lines: {service="api-gateway", customer="AtlasHealth", timestamp>="2026-02-25" and timestamp<="2026-03-02"}.
3) Confirmed sample hits containing PII in support-facing index.
logs_excerpt: 2026-02-27T14:12:03Z api-gateway INFO req_id=abc123 customer=AtlasHealth user_email=jane.doe@atlashealth.com prompt_id=pf_99...\n2026-02-28T09:04:17Z api-gateway INFO req_id=def456 customer=AtlasHealth user_email=redacted prompt_id=pf_101... (full logs redacted here for ticket)
investigation_notes: Initial triage: SRE confirmed data is present in hot Loki indexes and archived S3 prefixes (s3://logs-prod/2026-02/AtlasHealth/). Privacy note: logs may include full prompt text in a minority of entries. Hypotheses: 1) We can perform targeted deletions on the hot index via Loki DELETE API for the query window. 2) Cold backups on S3 need a separate purge workflow (rewrite or selective retention) and will require Legal sign-off to modify backup artifacts. Actions taken: - Snapshot of query results saved to secure ticket artifact store. - Identified S3 prefixes and retention manifests. - Opened PR for a safe delete job (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345) with dry-run mode.
comments: 2026-03-10 Priya Nair: Filed request after receiving DSAR escalation from AtlasHealth compliance; attaching customer email and list of sample log keys. Asked SRE for feasibility estimate.

2026-03-11 Evan Carter (SRE): Confirmed presence in Loki hot and S3 cold archives. Proposed two-step approach: hot-index delete + S3 retention manifest update. Flagging need for Legal sign-off for backup modification.
2026-03-11 Maya Ortiz (Privacy): Requested precise list of identifiers and statement of lawful basis. Provided privacy template to Legal for review.

2026-03-12 Legal (Aisha Khan): Reviewing HIPAA applicability and confirming that AtlasHealth's contract clause allows for data scrubbing upon verified request; asked Engineering to produce risk assessment.
2026-03-13 Evan Carter: Uploaded dry-run results from delete job to secure artifact store; no errors in delete of 12k lines in staging simulation. Awaiting Legal approval to run in prod.
resolution: Work in progress. Plan: (1) Legal to sign off on backup modification by 2026-03-15, (2) SRE to run production hot-index delete with coordination window, (3) After Legal approval, run S3 cold purge workflow and update retention manifests. Post-action: notify AtlasHealth Compliance and record change in audit log. No final deletion executed yet.
follow_up_tasks: Obtain Legal sign-off for backup modification
Execute hot-index delete and verify audit entries
Run S3 purge job and reconcile checksums
Create post-action report for customer and internal audit
resolution_notes: N/A - pending Legal approval and scheduled maintenance window.

estimated_risk: Moderate - possibility of incomplete deletion from backups if not handled carefully, risk of audit flags if process not fully documented.
